entries.name: technology-graph.md
entries.title: Technology Graph
entries.summary: Everything this repository builds with. There is no runtime and no dependency manifest here: the assets are Markdown and JSON, and the platforms below are what reads them. The technologies themselves live one chapter each in the layer files; this file is the map.

entries.name: hosts.md
entries.title: Hosts
entries.summary: The platforms that read an asset, the one that runs it, and the one library a host supplies at load time. Nothing in this layer is a dependency in a manifest; each is what the checked-in files are authored for.

entries.name: shared.md
entries.title: Shared
entries.summary: Formats and protocols that cut across every layer: what an asset is written in, and how a plugin ships tools rather than prose.

entries.name: tooling.md
entries.title: Tooling
entries.summary: What a plugin's executable parts run on. Both entries are runtimes a consuming repository already has; neither is installed by anything here.
